raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misapplied the truth/lie logic. They claimed that if all residents were vampires, the statement “At least one of us is a human” would contradict their lying nature, when in fact it would be a false statement consistent with vampires lying. They also incorrectly concluded that vampires would say the same (true) statement when at least one human exists, which would make vampires tell the truth. Correctly, unanimity on that statement implies it must be false, so there are no humans—i.e., all 100 are vampires.
